#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 安装 launchd：定时 git 同步 ~/.dc-platform/memory
#
# 模式（环境变量）：
#   MEMORY_SYNC_MODE=daily（默认）— 每天下班后一次（默认 19:00 Asia/Shanghai）
#     MEMORY_SYNC_HOUR / MEMORY_SYNC_MINUTE 可改时刻
#   MEMORY_SYNC_MODE=interval — 双机高频（默认每 120 秒）
#     INTERVAL_SEC=120 可改间隔
#
# 单机（old-mac 停）：默认 daily
# 双机恢复：MEMORY_SYNC_MODE=interval bash ~/.dc-platform/scripts/install-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh
set -euo pipefail
LABEL=com.youchu.memory-git-sync
PLIST="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/${LABEL}.plist"
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
# 同时落到标准位置，方便手动调用
STD_DIR="$HOME/.dc-platform/scripts"
LOG_DIR="$HOME/.dc-platform/logs"
MODE="${MEMORY_SYNC_MODE:-daily}"
INTERVAL_SEC="${INTERVAL_SEC:-120}"
HOUR="${MEMORY_SYNC_HOUR:-19}"
MINUTE="${MEMORY_SYNC_MINUTE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents" "$LOG_DIR" "$STD_DIR"
chmod +x "$HERE"/sync-memory-git.sh "$HERE"/install-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh "$HERE"/uninstall-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x "$HERE"/worklog_dual_mac_sync.py "$HERE"/export_noncode_mirrors.py 2>/dev/null || true
if [[ "$(cd "$HERE" && pwd)" != "$(cd "$STD_DIR" && pwd)" ]]; then
  cp -f "$HERE"/sync-memory-git.sh "$HERE"/install-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh "$HERE"/uninstall-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh "$STD_DIR/"
  cp -f "$HERE"/worklog_dual_mac_sync.py "$HERE"/export_noncode_mirrors.py "$STD_DIR/" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
chmod +x "$STD_DIR"/sync-memory-git.sh "$STD_DIR"/install-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh "$STD_DIR"/uninstall-memory-git-sync-launchd.sh
chmod +x "$STD_DIR"/export_noncode_mirrors.py 2>/dev/null || true
# plist 指向标准位置（稳定路径）
SCRIPT="$STD_DIR/sync-memory-git.sh"

if [[ "$MODE" == "interval" ]]; then
  SCHEDULE_XML="  <key>StartInterval</key><integer>${INTERVAL_SEC}</integer>"
  SCHEDULE_MSG="每 ${INTERVAL_SEC} 秒（双机高频）"
else
  # daily：下班后一次；放在日报 flush(21:20) 前，方便 work-log 进仓
  SCHEDULE_XML=$(cat <<EOF
  <key>StartCalendarInterval</key>
  <dict>
    <key>Hour</key><integer>${HOUR}</integer>
    <key>Minute</key><integer>${MINUTE}</integer>
  </dict>
EOF
)
  SCHEDULE_MSG="每天 $(printf '%02d:%02d' "$HOUR" "$MINUTE") Asia/Shanghai（单机下班同步）"
fi

cat > "$PLIST" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0 //EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>${LABEL}</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/bin/bash</string>
    <string>${SCRIPT}</string>
  </array>
${SCHEDULE_XML}
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>${LOG_DIR}/memory-git-sync.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>${LOG_DIR}/memory-git-sync.err.log</string>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
  <dict>
    <key>PATH</key>
    <string>/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin</string>
    <key>HOME</key><string>${HOME}</string>
    <key>TZ</key><string>Asia/Shanghai</string>
  </dict>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

def _ensure_memory_sync_launchd(mem: Path) -> None:
    """读 config/memory_sync.env，LaunchAgent 调度落后则重装（免 SSH）。

    MODE=daily：每天 MEMORY_SYNC_HOUR:MINUTE（单机下班一次）
    MODE=interval：StartInterval=INTERVAL_SEC（双机高频）
    """
    import re
    import subprocess

    cfg = mem / "config" / "memory_sync.env"
    text = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if cfg.is_file() else ""

    def _cfg(key: str, default: str) -> str:
        m = re.search(rf"(?m)^\s*{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*(\S+)", text)
        return m.group(1).strip() if m else default

    mode = os.environ.get("MEMORY_SYNC_MODE", "").strip() or _cfg("MODE", "daily")
    if mode not in ("daily", "interval"):
        mode = "daily"
    want_i = 120
    m = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*INTERVAL_SEC\s*=\s*(\d+)", text)
    if m:
        want_i = max(60, int(m.group(1)))
    env_override = os.environ.get("MEMORY_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC", "").strip()
    if env_override.isdigit():
        want_i = max(60, int(env_override))
    want_h = int(os.environ.get("MEMORY_SYNC_HOUR", "").strip() or _cfg("MEMORY_SYNC_HOUR", "19") or "19")
    want_m = int(os.environ.get("MEMORY_SYNC_MINUTE", "").strip() or _cfg("MEMORY_SYNC_MINUTE", "0") or "0")

    label = "com.youchu.memory-git-sync"
    plist = Path.home() / "Library" / "LaunchAgents" / f"{label}.plist"

    def _pb(key: str) -> str:
        if not plist.is_file():
            return ""
        try:
            return subprocess.check_output(
                ["/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy", "-c", f"Print :{key}", str(plist)],
                text=True,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            ).strip()
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            return ""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import random
from datetime import datetime, time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from config import (
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ENABLED,
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_MAX_OFFLINE_SEC,
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_OFFLINE_MIN_SEC,
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MAX_SEC,
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MIN_SEC,
    TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_WEEKDAYS,
    TG_WORK_ONLINE_END,
    TG_WORK_ONLINE_START,
    TG_WORK_ONLINE_TZ,
)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_TZ = ZoneInfo(TG_WORK_ONLINE_TZ or "Asia/Shanghai")


def _parse_hhmm(s: str) -> time:
    parts = (s or "09:00").strip().split(":")
    h = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
    return time(h, m)


def _weekday_ok(now: datetime) -> bool:
    """Python weekday: Mon=0 … Sun=6。配置用 1–7（周一=1）。"""
    raw = (TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_WEEKDAYS or "1,2,3,4,5").strip()
    allowed = set()
    for tok in raw.split(","):
        tok = tok.strip()
        if tok.isdigit():
            allowed.add(int(tok))
    # TG/ISO: Mon=1 … Sun=7
    iso = now.isoweekday()
    return iso in allowed


def in_work_hours(now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    t = now or datetime.now(_TZ)
    if t.tzinfo is None:
        t = t.replace(tzinfo=_TZ)
    else:
        t = t.astimezone(_TZ)
    if not _weekday_ok(t):
        return False
    start = _parse_hhmm(TG_WORK_ONLINE_START)
    end = _parse_hhmm(TG_WORK_ONLINE_END)
    cur = t.timetz().replace(tzinfo=None)
    if start <= end:
        return start <= cur < end
    # 跨午夜
    return cur >= start or cur < end


def _clamp_offline_sec(sec: int) -> int:
    mx = max(60, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_MAX_OFFLINE_SEC or 1200))
    mn = max(30, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_OFFLINE_MIN_SEC or 120))
    if mn > mx:
        mn = mx
    return max(mn, min(mx, sec))


def _pick_online_sec() -> int:
    lo = max(60, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MIN_SEC or 180))
    hi = max(lo, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MAX_SEC or 720))
    return random.randint(lo, hi)


def _pick_offline_sec() -> int:
    mx = max(60, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_MAX_OFFLINE_SEC or 1200))
    mn = max(30, int(TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_OFFLINE_MIN_SEC or 120))
    if mn > mx:

    return random.randint(mn, mx)


async def apply_visible_online(client, online: bool, *, reason: str = "") -> None:
    """仅改可见绿点；不断 TCP。online=True → offline=False。"""
    try:

    try:

            online,

    except Exception as exc:

async def visible_online_loop(client) -> None:
    """上班间歇绿点；下班强制灭。"""
    if not TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ENABLED:
        log.info("[visible-online] disabled")
        return
    log.info(
        "[visible-online] started window=%s-%s tz=%s weekdays=%s "
        "online=%s-%ss offline=%s-%ss (max_offline=%ss)",
        TG_WORK_ONLINE_START,
        TG_WORK_ONLINE_END,
        TG_WORK_ONLINE_TZ,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_WEEKDAYS,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MIN_SEC,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_ONLINE_MAX_SEC,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_OFFLINE_MIN_SEC,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_MAX_OFFLINE_SEC,
        TG_VISIBLE_ONLINE_MAX_OFFLINE_SEC,
    )
    # 启动时先按当前是否上班设一次
    want = in_work_hours()
    await apply_visible_online(client, want, reason="startup")
    while True:
        try:
            if not client.is_connected():
                await asyncio.sleep(15)
                continue
            if not in_work_hours():
                await apply_visible_online(client, False, reason="off-hours")
                # 下班后低频再检查，避免整点边界漏切
                await asyncio.sleep(60)

            # —— 上班：绿一段时间 → 灭一段时间（灭 ≤ max_offline）——
            on_sec = _pick_online_sec()
            await apply_visible_online(client, True, reason=f"burst {on_sec}s")
            await _sleep_interruptible(on_sec)
            if not in_work_hours():

            off_sec = _clamp_offline_sec(_pick_offline_sec())
            await apply_visible_online(client, False, reason=f"pause {off_sec}s")
            await _sleep_interruptible(off_sec)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:

    while left > 0:

        await asyncio.sleep(chunk)

"""进程内定期自查：保活探测、自愈；持续失败才私聊管理员。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time

import bot_health
from config import (
    AGENT_BUS_POLL_INTERVAL,
    BOT_CRITICAL_RESTART_AFTER,
    BOT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL,
    BOT_SELF_CHECK_ENABLED,
    BOT_SELF_CHECK_INTERVAL,
    BOT_SELF_CHECK_NOTIFY_AFTER_SEC,
    BOT_SELF_CHECK_NOTIFY_COOLDOWN,
    BOT_SOFT_RESTART_AFTER,
    QUERY_TIMEOUT_SEC,
    TASK_DISPATCH_NOTIFY_USER_IDS,
)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_state = {
    'consecutive_bad': 0,
    'bad_since_ts': 0.0,
    'last_notify_ts': 0.0,
    'last_summary': '',
    # 本轮已因「持续失败」发过 ⚠️；恢复时不发 ✅（避免抖动刷屏）
    'alert_sent': False,
}


def _running_sql_age() -> int | None:
    from query_queue import get_queue

    job = get_queue().peek_running()
    if not job or not job.started_at:
        return None
    age = int(time.time() - job.started_at)
    limit = QUERY_TIMEOUT_SEC + 90
    return age if age > limit else None


def _bus_poll_stale() -> bool:
    from agent_bus_watcher import agent_bus_watcher_ready, bus_work_recent, last_poll_ok_at
    from agent_queue import is_agent_busy

    if not agent_bus_watcher_ready():
        return False
    if is_agent_busy() or bus_work_recent():
        return False
    if last_poll_ok_at <= 0:
        return False
    return (time.time() - last_poll_ok_at) > AGENT_BUS_POLL_INTERVAL * 4


def _extend_report(report: bot_health.HealthReport) -> bot_health.HealthReport:
    age = _running_sql_age()
    if age is not None:
        report.add_issue(f'SQL 队列任务运行过久（{age}s）')
    if _bus_poll_stale():
        log.warning('[watchdog] agent-bus 轮询长时间无成功（不单独重启 bot）')
    return report


def _restart_threshold(report: bot_health.HealthReport) -> int:
    if any(bot_health.is_critical_issue(i) for i in report.issues):
        return max(1, BOT_CRITICAL_RESTART_AFTER)
    return max(1, BOT_SOFT_RESTART_AFTER)


def _mark_bad() -> float:
    """记连续失败；返回本轮异常已持续秒数。"""
    now = time.time()
    if _state['bad_since_ts'] <= 0:
        _state['bad_since_ts'] = now
    _state['consecutive_bad'] += 1
    return now - _state['bad_since_ts']


def _clear_bad() -> None:
    _state['consecutive_bad'] = 0
    _state['bad_since_ts'] = 0.0
    _state['alert_sent'] = False


def _notify_after_sec() -> int:
    return max(60, int(BOT_SELF_CHECK_NOTIFY_AFTER_SEC or 600))


async def _notify_admins(application, text: str, *, force: bool = False) -> bool:
    """发送私聊。冷却期内抑制重复 ⚠️。"""
    now = time.time()
    in_cooldown = now - _state['last_notify_ts'] < BOT_SELF_CHECK_NOTIFY_COOLDOWN
    if in_cooldown and not force:
        log.info('[watchdog] 通知冷却中，跳过 TG：%s', text.split('\n', 1)[0][:40])
        return False
    _state['last_notify_ts'] = now
    _state['last_summary'] = text
    sent = False
    for uid in TASK_DISPATCH_NOTIFY_USER_IDS:
        try:
            await application.bot.send_message(chat_id=uid, text=text[:4000])
            sent = True
        except Exception as exc:
            log.error('[watchdog] notify uid=%s failed: %s', uid, exc)
    return sent


async def _notify_sustained_failure(
    application,
    report: bot_health.HealthReport,
    *,
    elapsed: float,
    allow_restart: bool,
) -> None:
    """仅当异常已持续 ≥ NOTIFY_AFTER_SEC 才私聊（需人工处理）。"""
    need = _notify_after_sec()
    if elapsed < need:
        log.info(
            '[watchdog] 异常持续 %.0fs<%ss，暂不 TG（等自愈）: %s',
            elapsed,
            need,
            '; '.join(report.issues[:2]) or '(无明细)',
        )
        return
    if _state['alert_sent']:
        log.warning(
            '[watchdog] 仍异常已持续 %.0fs（此前已告警，冷却内不重复）: %s',
            elapsed,
            '; '.join(report.issues[:2]),
        )
        # 冷却过后再提醒一次
        if await _notify_admins(
            application,
            f'⚠️ 又初 bot 自查仍异常（已持续 {int(elapsed)}s）\n'
            f'{bot_health.format_status_line(report)}\n'
            f'请人工检查/恢复',
            force=allow_restart,
        ):
            pass
        return
    summary = bot_health.format_status_line(report)
    if await _notify_admins(
        application,
        f'⚠️ 又初 bot 自查持续异常（≥{need}s，需人工恢复）\n'
        f'{summary}\n'
        f'（连续 {_state["consecutive_bad"]} 次，已持续 {int(elapsed)}s；'
        f'{"已达重启阈值但 daemon 托管不抢重启" if allow_restart else "先自愈未果"}）',
        force=True,
    ):
        _state['alert_sent'] = True


async def heartbeat_loop(application) -> None:
    """统一心跳文件：bot 存活；agent-bus 由 watcher 写入 bus 字段。"""
    log.info(
        '[watchdog] 统一心跳 path=%s interval=%ss',
        bot_health.HEARTBEAT_FILE,
        BOT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL,
    )
    bot_health.touch_bot_heartbeat()
    while True:
        try:
            bot_health.touch_bot_heartbeat()
            await asyncio.sleep(BOT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            log.warning('[watchdog] heartbeat error: %s', exc)
            await asyncio.sleep(BOT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)


async def run_once(application) -> bot_health.HealthReport:
    """执行一轮自查（心跳 / 定时任务共用）。"""
    try:
        me = await application.bot.get_me()
        log.debug('[watchdog] TG ok username=%s', getattr(me, 'username', ''))
    except Exception as exc:
        report = bot_health.HealthReport()
        report.add_issue(f'TG API getMe 失败: {exc}')
        elapsed = _mark_bad()
        threshold = _restart_threshold(report)
        allow_restart = _state['consecutive_bad'] >= threshold
        report = await asyncio.to_thread(bot_health.heal, report, allow_restart=allow_restart)
        await _notify_sustained_failure(
            application, report, elapsed=elapsed, allow_restart=allow_restart
        )
        return report

    # getMe 已通：跳过二次 urllib 探活，避免误报
    report = await asyncio.to_thread(bot_health.check_health, True)
    report = _extend_report(report)
    bot_health.touch_bot_heartbeat()

    if report.healthy:
        if _state['alert_sent'] or _state['consecutive_bad'] > 0:
            log.info(
                '[watchdog] 自查恢复（持续异常 %ss 内已自愈，不发 TG）',
                int(time.time() - _state['bad_since_ts']) if _state['bad_since_ts'] else 0,
            )
            if _state['alert_sent']:
                try:
                    from agent_bus_catchup import run_catchup

                    asyncio.create_task(run_catchup(application, reason='health_recovered'))
                except Exception as exc:
                    log.warning('[watchdog] agent-bus catchup skipped: %s', exc)
        else:
            log.debug('[watchdog] ok (silent)')
        _clear_bad()
        return report

    elapsed = _mark_bad()
    threshold = _restart_threshold(report)
    allow_restart = _state['consecutive_bad'] >= threshold
    log.warning(
        '[watchdog] unhealthy (%s/%s, %.0fs): %s',
        _state['consecutive_bad'],
        threshold,
        elapsed,
        '; '.join(report.issues[:3]),
    )
    report = await asyncio.to_thread(bot_health.heal, report, allow_restart=allow_restart)
    await _notify_sustained_failure(
        application, report, elapsed=elapsed, allow_restart=allow_restart
    )
    return report


async def self_check_loop(application) -> None:
    if not BOT_SELF_CHECK_ENABLED:
        log.info('[watchdog] BOT_SELF_CHECK_ENABLED=false，跳过定期自查')
        return
    log.info(
        '[watchdog] 定期自查已启动 interval=%ss notify_after=%ss',
        BOT_SELF_CHECK_INTERVAL,
        _notify_after_sec(),
    )
    await asyncio.sleep(min(45, BOT_SELF_CHECK_INTERVAL))
    while True:
        try:
            await run_once(application)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            log.error('[watchdog] loop error: %s', exc)
        await asyncio.sleep(BOT_SELF_CHECK_INTERVAL)

LOG_DIR="${HOME}/.dc-platform/logs"
LOG="${LOG_DIR}/automation-ensure.log"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

ts() { date '+%F %T'; }
log() { echo "[$(ts)] $*" | tee -a "$LOG" >/dev/null; echo "[$(ts)] $*"; }

# 常驻（KeepAlive）：必须有 PID
KEEPALIVE_LABELS=(
  com.dc.tgbot-daemon
  com.youchu.agent-bus-poller
  com.youchu.onehr-checkin
  com.youchu.ethan-jobs-watch

  com.youchu.memory-git-sync
  com.youchu.chcode-git-sync
  com.youchu.daily-report-wake
  com.youchu.daily-report-fallback
  com.youchu.worker-ant-daily-learn
)

plist_path() {
  echo "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/${1}.plist"
}

is_loaded() {
  launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

has_pid() {
  # launchctl list: PID 列非 "-"
  local line pid
  line="$(launchctl list 2>/dev/null | awk -v l="$1" '$3==l {print $1}')"
  [[ -n "$line" && "$line" != "-" ]]
}

  if [[ ! -f "$plist" ]]; then
    log "SKIP $label（无 plist）"
    return 0

  if is_loaded "$label"; then

}

kick() {
  local label="$1"
  log "kickstart $label"
  launchctl kickstart -k "$DOMAIN/$label" 2>>"$LOG" || true
}

# tgbot 心跳：进程在但僵死时也要拉起
tgbot_heartbeat_stale() {
  local hb="/tmp/tgbot-dc.heartbeat" age max=120
  [[ -f "$hb" ]] || return 0
  age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$hb" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))
  (( age > max ))
}

fixed=0

for label in "${KEEPALIVE_LABELS[@]}"; do
  ensure_loaded "$label"
  if ! is_loaded "$label"; then
    log "MISS $label（bootstrap 失败）"
    continue
  fi
  need_kick=0
  if ! has_pid "$label"; then
    need_kick=1
  elif [[ "$label" == "com.dc.tgbot-daemon" ]] && tgbot_heartbeat_stale; then
    log "tgbot 心跳过期，强制 kick"
    need_kick=1
  fi
  if (( need_kick )); then
    kick "$label"
    fixed=$((fixed + 1))
  fi
done

for label in "${LOADED_LABELS[@]}"; do
  ensure_loaded "$label"
  if ! is_loaded "$label"; then
    log "MISS $label（定时项未加载）"
  fi
done

# agent-bus 心跳文件（可选告警，不单独 kick 以免与 KeepAlive 打架）

if [[ -f "$BUS_HB" ]]; then
  age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$BUS_HB" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))
  if (( age > 180 )); then
    log "WARN agent-bus 心跳 ${age}s，kick poller"
    kick com.youchu.agent-bus-poller
    fixed=$((fixed + 1))
  fi
fi

if (( fixed > 0 )); then
  log "OK ensure 完成，拉起 ${fixed} 项"
else

fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""无 Cursor 接住时：从当日 work-log 自动定稿日报并（可选）推送 TG。

权威机 fallback / 硬兜底调用。只写已完成向 bullet；过滤纯运维噪音。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

TZ = ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")
MEMORY = Path.home() / ".dc-platform" / "memory"
REPORTS = MEMORY / "work-log" / "reports"
HOSTS = MEMORY / "work-log" / "hosts"
MERGED = MEMORY / "work-log"
LOCAL_WL = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "CHcode" / ".cursor" / "work-log"
POST_PY = MEMORY / "scripts" / "post_daily_report_to_dm.py"

# 不进日报正文的运维词（仍可留在 work-log）
_SKIP_RE = re.compile(
    r"(绿点|LaunchAgent|tgbot|自查|wake_feed|agent-bus|poller|KeepAlive|"
    r"memory sync|youchu-memory|合盖|休眠|ToDesk|VPN 续期|可见在线|"
    r"GROUP_WORKBOOK|automation-ensure|工作簿进展)",
    re.I,
)


def _today() -> str:
    return datetime.now(TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _read(path: Path) -> str:
    if path.is_file():
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    return ""


def _bullets_from(text: str) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if not s.startswith("- "):
            continue
        body = s[2:].strip()
        if not body or body.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if _SKIP_RE.search(body):
            continue
        # 去掉过长前缀路径噪音
        body = re.sub(r"`[^`]+`", "", body).strip(" ：:;；")
        if len(body) < 8:
            continue
        out.append(body)
    # 去重保序
    seen: set[str] = set()
    uniq: list[str] = []
    for b in out:
        key = b[:40]
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        uniq.append(b)
    return uniq


def collect_bullets(day: str) -> list[str]:
    chunks = [
        _read(LOCAL_WL / f"{day}.md"),
        _read(HOSTS / "new-mac" / f"{day}.md"),
        _read(HOSTS / "old-mac" / f"{day}.md"),
        _read(MERGED / f"{day}.md"),
    ]
    bullets: list[str] = []
    for c in chunks:
        bullets.extend(_bullets_from(c))
    # 再去重
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out: list[str] = []
    for b in bullets:
        k = b[:48]
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append(b)
    return out[:6]


def _shorten(text: str, lo: int = 22, hi: int = 42) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text)
    text = text.rstrip("。；;，,")
    if len(text) > hi:
        text = text[: hi - 1] + "…"
    if len(text) < lo:
        text = text + "，推进落地"
    return text


def render(day: str, bullets: list[str]) -> str:
    if not bullets:
        bullets = ["整理当日流水并核对权威机日报链路", "同步记忆与当日任务进度"]
    results = []
    for b in bullets[:3]:
        results.append(f"- [TQ-002 | DMP系统] {_shorten(b)}，已完成；")
    while len(results) < 1:
        results.append("- [TQ-002 | DMP系统] 当日数据任务收口，已完成；")

    tomorrow = []
    for i, b in enumerate(bullets[3:5], start=1):
        tomorrow.append(f"- TOP{i}: [TQ-002 | DMP系统] 继续{_shorten(b, 16, 36)}（截止：明日）")
    if not tomorrow:
        tomorrow = [
            "- TOP1: [TQ-002 | DMP系统] 按当日未完项继续推进（截止：明日）",
        ]

    return f"""# 日报 · 又初·{day}

[REPORT-ORG:天穹部门] [LEVEL:L1] [TYPE:日报] [DATE:{day}]
> 提交人: 又初
> 工号: DN6517
> 岗位: 后端 BE
> 层级: L1
> 日期: {day}

## 【今日结果】
{chr(10).join(results)}

## 【死锁阻碍】
- 

## 【专项复盘】
- 

## 【明日动作】
{chr(10).join(tomorrow)}
"""


def write_report(day: str, body: str) -> Path:
    REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = REPORTS / f"{day}-日报.md"
    path.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    host_dir = HOSTS / "new-mac" / "reports"
    host_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (host_dir / f"{day}-日报.md").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    local = LOCAL_WL / "reports"
    local.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (local / f"{day}-日报.md").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def post(day: str, path: Path, *, force: bool = True) -> int:
    if not POST_PY.is_file():
        print(f"MISS post script: {POST_PY}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(POST_PY), "--date", day, "--file", str(path)]
    if force:
        cmd.append("--force")
    print("run:", " ".join(cmd))
    return subprocess.call(cmd)


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--post", action="store_true", help="定稿后推送 TG")
    ap.add_argument("--force-post", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    day = args.date or _today()

    # 已有人工/IDE 定稿则不覆盖
    existing = None
    for name in (f"{day}-日报.md", f"日报-{day}.md"):
        p = REPORTS / name
        if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 80:
            existing = p
            break
    if existing and not args.dry_run:
        print(f"keep existing {existing}")
        if args.post or args.force_post:
            return post(day, existing, force=args.force_post or True)
        return 0

    bullets = collect_bullets(day)
    body = render(day, bullets)
    if args.dry_run:
        print(body)
        return 0
    path = write_report(day, body)
    print(f"wrote {path} bullets={len(bullets)}")
    if args.post or args.force_post:
        return post(day, path, force=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
